title: call_transcribe.input.v1
description: Input of the call.transcribe.v1 job: a call recording the CRM uploaded with PUT /v1/audio/{ref} for this tenant. The audio itself is not in the job input.

audio_ref.description: Reference given when the recording was uploaded.

language.description: Spoken language. Kyrgyz needs a separately configured speech model.

channels.description: mono: one channel, speakers are not separated. manager_left / manager_right: a stereo recording where the manager is on that channel and the customer on the other (usual for telephony).

call_ref.description: Opaque reference to the CRM call record. Not interpreted by the platform.
